title: The Report of the Lost and Found
youtube_title: The Report of the Lost and Found | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Yael about report from the lost and found, item by item. Yael wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
